incarnation: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1980) — Bespin Sith Lord

slots.poseBrief: Standing in three-quarter front view, feet apart, right hand holding the red lightsaber lowered diagonally away from the body and left fist resting at his belt; complete helmet, chest box, boots and cape readable. Calm commanding reference attitude, no attack.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Cloud City observation bay near an arrival platform.

slots.themeBrief: Sabre rouge de Vader — poignée MPP
slots.poseBrief: No character. One complete Vader red lightsaber diagonally displayed on two small insulated cradles; silver MPP tubular hilt with black angled emitter shroud, black T-track grips, central clamp with bubble control strip and D-ring. Full red blade and full hilt inside frame.
slots.backgroundDescription: Imperial armory inspection bench aboard a period support shuttle.

slots.themeBrief: Puits technique de Bespin — décor seul
slots.poseBrief: Environment only, no figures or weapons. Wide elevated view of a deep cylindrical Cloud City reactor/processing shaft with narrow projecting gantries, short railings and vertically banded indicator panels.
slots.backgroundDescription: Cloud City deep industrial processing shaft inspired by the official ESB platform still.

slots.poseBrief: Leaning slightly forward to examine a small illuminated facility schematic on a console, left glove resting on the control edge and right index finger selecting one control; saber unlit on belt, helmet remains sealed.
slots.backgroundDescription: Cloud City security-control alcove compatible with the ESB era.

slots.poseBrief: Strong lateral stance with left foot forward and cape swept back; left gloved palm extended to move several small machinery panels through the air while right hand holds the single red saber in a low defensive line. No lightning, no beam from the hand, no injured target.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Bespin machinery hall for a Nexus adaptation of documented debris telekinesis.

slots.themeBrief: Arrivée au hangar de Cloud City
slots.poseBrief: Walking forward through a wide doorway, right boot just crossing the threshold, left hand gathering cape slightly to avoid the door edge, right hand relaxed near the unlit saber at belt; body in three-quarter side view.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Cloud City shuttle hangar entrance in the ESB period.

slots.poseBrief: Standing in full left profile at an empty command dais, torso upright, both hands clasped behind the back, helmet turned toward a window; unlit silver-black saber at belt, cape hanging in a long controlled silhouette.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Imperial command dais in a period cruiser near Bespin.

slots.poseBrief: Low defensive crouch behind a waist-high machinery housing, right knee bent deeply and left foot braced to retreat; both gloved hands hold the red saber horizontally in a protective guard; intact sealed helmet and working chest box.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Bespin condenser service gallery during a tactical withdrawal.

slots.poseBrief: Fully armored and sealed Vader seated sideways on a sturdy folding chair under a large plain sunshade, one glove holding a small sandcastle mold and the other resting on his knee. Helmet, respirator, chest box, suit, gloves and boots stay on; cape neatly draped. No weapon in hand. Calm dry deadpan humor, no human face.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original sandy coastal moon in the Age of Rebellion; unofficial leisure scenario, not Bespin.

slots.poseBrief: Fully armored sealed Vader taking a measured sideways step to place a closed meal-tray stack on a utility counter using both gloved hands. A simple gray service apron is tied OVER the armor without covering the chest control box; saber unlit at belt, respirator and all life-support equipment unchanged.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Imperial transport mess counter in a family-safe unofficial service scenario.

slots.themeBrief: La cape et le droïde nettoyeur
slots.poseBrief: Controlled comic near-stumble: one boot lifted over a small floor-cleaning droid, torso leaning sideways, left glove carefully lifting the cape hem caught under the droid wheel while right palm holds balance; fully sealed original armor, dignified deadpan helmet. Saber unlit on belt.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original polished Cloud City corridor with an ordinary cleaning droid.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit alternative moral alignment: viewed from three-quarter rear, Vader plants both boots and braces a damaged cargo door with both gloved hands to keep a safe exit open; helmet turns back toward camera. Original black life-support armor unchanged; saber unlit on belt. No victims or injuries depicted.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original orbital cargo station evacuation bay in an alternate post-Bespin branch.

slots.themeBrief: Tenue de Grand Amiral — variation extérieure
slots.poseBrief: Explicit iconic outfit reinterpretation only, not a gender change: full black ESB helmet and life-support armor retained, overlaid with a white Grand-Admiral-inspired open ceremonial mantle and restrained gold shoulder boards. Chest box remains exposed and functional. Full right profile presenting the white outer layer, left hand adjusting its clasp and right hand holding unlit MPP saber at his side.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Imperial ceremonial rotunda in an unofficial costume What If.

slots.themeBrief: Corruption du côté obscur — sans gore
slots.poseBrief: Explicit noncanon armor corruption: Vader stands tilted forward with left glove gripping the edge of a stone relic plinth and right arm held tensely outward, fingers partly curled. Same sealed helmet and life-support armor intact, chest box working; subtle dim violet mineral-like traces on the cape edge only. Unlit saber at belt, no exposed flesh, no lightning or new limbs.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original abandoned Sith relic vault in a clearly noncanon corruption scenario.

slots.themeBrief: Avenir alternatif — cinq ans après Bespin
slots.poseBrief: Explicit hypothetical branch five years after Bespin in which Vader survives; not the canonical Endor outcome. Fully sealed ESB-style life-support armor carefully maintained with a lightly repaired cape, no face exposed. Walking in full side profile along an inspection balcony, rear boot leaving floor; left hand holding a compact datapad while right hand rests on the railing, unlit MPP saber at belt.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original deep-space observatory in an alternative future five years after Bespin.
